Label: Basket notice
Content: Final prices, stock and collection-point availability are checked at confirmation.

Label: Empty basket text
Content: Return to the shop to add products.

Label: Collection introduction
Content: Select a collection point that can fulfil everything in your basket.

Label: Member verification introduction
Content: Enter your email and we will send your secure ordering link.

Label: Payment explanation
Content: Your regular commitment is paid by BACS standing order. If this order takes your balance below zero, you can make an extra bank transfer (recommended) or use the secure online payment option shown on your dashboard and in your confirmation email.

Label: Balance requirement
Content: Your balance must be £0.00 or above before collection for the order to be fulfilled. If payment has not been received before orders are prepared, your order will be refunded and the produce returned to available stock.

Label: Bank transfer note
Content: Bank transfers avoid payment-processing costs and help us keep member prices low.

Label: Non-member introduction
Content: Join Rooted Commons to order from the weekly market and help strengthen the local food network.

Label: Commitment explanation
Content: Your regular contribution creates predictable demand that local producers can plan around.

Label: Regular payment explanation
Content: Please use a weekly standing order for your core commitment. BACS is the only payment method offered for this regular payment.

Label: Regular payment note
Content: Regular BACS payments have no processing charge and help us keep member prices low.

Label: Top-ups explanation
Content: Your regular standing order is intended to cover your normal weekly spending. If you spend more than your available credit, you can make a one-off bank transfer (recommended) or pay online for convenience.

Label: Bank top-up note
Content: Bank transfers have no processing charge and help us keep member prices low.

Label: Online payment explanation
Content: Online payment is available for convenience when you need to top up immediately.

Label: Online unavailable message
Content: Online payment is temporarily unavailable. You can still top up by bank transfer.
